parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—sorry about the interruption to finance’s workflow. We’re escalating this to our engineering team as a high-priority issue: the CSV export button on the invoice page is returning a 500 error, while customer exports are not affected.

To help us pinpoint the failing request quickly, could you share the following (any one or two items is fine to start)?
1) The timestamp of the first failure this morning (and your timezone)
2) The exact error details from the 500 response, especially any request/correlation ID from your browser dev tools or the UI error message
3) Which invoice export action/endpoint the button triggers (if you can see it), or the URL of the invoice page where it fails
4) Whether it happens every time or only for specific invoice IDs/date ranges/users
5) Confirm the environment (prod vs staging) where you’re seeing it

In the meantime, thanks for the workaround—please keep using it until we confirm what’s causing the invoice-page export to fail. We’ll follow up as soon as we have the failing logs/request details reviewed by engineering.
